name: clook-ftp-monitor
description: A lightweight dashboard for monitoring FTP uploads on cPanel servers with Pure-FTPd
summary: Tracks all file uploads to FTP on your cPanel server in real time, giving you clear stats on who uploaded what, when, and how much data was transferred. The dashboard helps IT or operations staff quickly spot unusual upload activity and filter uploads by user or filename. It removes the need to dig through logs manually and keeps everything secure by using existing login sessions.
